source: https://apps.api.manifoldxyz.dev/public/instance/data?id=73296112 (backing API for the live claim page https://app.manifold.xyz/c/MZGPFP2), fetched 2026-08-01
about: First-party Manifold claim-page record for MetaZoo Games PFP 2.0. This is the mint page's own data: the claim title, the description MetaZoo authored, the free mint price, the redemption window and the claim supply.

notes.claim_title: NFTina - the claim page is titled after the cat, not after the contract name 'MetaZoo Games PFP 2.0'.
notes.description_verbatim: The authored description is complete as stored: a sentence broken off mid-word ('Seri-'), then '...', then '*Meow*', then '...'. It is not truncated by our fetch.
notes.corroborates_total_mints: publicData.tokenSupply == 2381 == our on-chain total_mints for pfp_2.
notes.corroborates_free_mint: mintPrice 0 ETH confirms the on-chain primary revenue (~1.19 ETH) is gas/mint-fee only, not a sale price. The real cost was the physical box (see collection_content.json pfp_2.off_chain_basis).
notes.claim_code_gating: signatureAddress is set with walletMax 0 and mintingRestriction 'None', i.e. access was gated by signed claim codes rather than an allowlist. Matches Manifold's own Claim Codes case study (manifold_metazoo.json).
